title: OpenAI's ChatGPT app store now has 300+ app integrations six months after its launch, but faces sluggish adoption due to limited functionality for many apps (Natalie Lung/Bloomberg)
summary: Natalie Lung / Bloomberg: OpenAI's ChatGPT app store now has 300+ app integrations six months after its launch, but faces sluggish adoption due to limited functionality for many apps — Six months in, ChatGPT's third-party apps offer limited functionality and have been frustrating for developers.
